parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem:
Monoclonal antibodies (MAbs) have been used in the treatment of some non-infectious diseases.

MAbs can be designed to bind to a protein on diseased cells, so causing their destruction by cells of the person's immune system.
parts.text: Name the part of an antibody molecule that will bind to a protein on diseased cells.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest how the binding of monoclonal antibody to the diseased cells causes their destruction by cells of the person's immune system.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Myasthenia gravis is an auto-immune disease.

Explain the term *auto-immune disease*.
